_readme: Ownership and membership tiers as published by The Sentinel Syndicate (2024 flyers). Prices are in USD as supplied. Set 'priceKES' on any tier once a KES price is confirmed and it will be shown alongside. Leave a field as null to show 'Confirmed on enquiry'.

ownership.title: Ownership Shares
ownership.intro: Hold a direct share in the syndicate's racehorses, measured in units. One unit represents a 1% ownership interest.

structure.note: The Sentinel Syndicate (founder and management) retains 55%. Up to 45% is offered to members. Ask us about current availability.

tiers.name: Entry
benefits: A proportionate interest in racing and any breeding outcomes, as set out in the ownership agreement

tiers.name: Growth
benefits: A proportionate interest in racing and any breeding outcomes, as set out in the ownership agreement
Priority access to future ownership opportunities

tiers.name: Strategic
benefits: A proportionate interest in racing and any breeding outcomes, as set out in the ownership agreement
Right of first refusal on future syndicate opportunities

membership.title: Club Membership
membership.intro: Annual membership of The Sentinel Syndicate's circle - sport, network and shared experiences, with or without an ownership share.

tiers.name: Silver
benefits: Jockey Owner (VIP) event access, all season
Access to a discreet business network
Invitations to member events and socials

tiers.name: Gold
benefits: Jockey Owner (VIP) event access, all season
Polo club VIP event access (half season)
Access to a discreet business network
Invitations to member events and socials
Priority access to selected equine experiences

tiers.name: Diamond
benefits: Jockey Owner (VIP) event access, all season
Polo club VIP event access, all season
Access to a discreet business network
Invitations to member events and socials
Priority access to selected equine experiences

membership.footnote: Membership benefits are as published by The Sentinel Syndicate. Venues, schedules and access are confirmed in writing when you join and remain subject to the terms of membership and the availability of partner venues.
